manualRef: Paper authority: desk-ai-robot/demo-build/README-DEMO.md (wiring table, flash steps, test checklist). Pin map below is copied from that file, not invented here.

parts.name: Half-size breadboard
parts.notes: Rails along the long edges. Everything seats here. No case in Demo Build 1, you need to see the wiring.

parts.name: XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense
parts.notes: 21 x 17.5 mm. Camera board is on the back and stays plugged in, pointing forward at the student. USB-C port faces left.

parts.name: OLED 0.96 in SSD1306
parts.notes: I2C address 0x3C. SDA to D4, SCL to D5, VCC to 3V3, GND to GND. This is the face: mouth moves when it speaks.

parts.name: INMP441 mic module
parts.notes: Qoroos 5-pack board, round. VDD 3V3 ONLY, never 5V. L/R pin to GND for left channel. SCK to D0, WS to D1, SD to D3.

parts.name: MAX98357A amp board
parts.notes: I2S amp, not a plain speaker. BCLK to D0, WS to D1, DIN to D2 (move to D6 if the board will not boot). VIN 5V first, 3V3 if it buzzes.

parts.name: Speaker, 36 mm 8 ohm 2 W
parts.notes: Adafruit 36 mm, product 6486. Wires to the amp output + and -. Do not power the speaker from the XIAO 3V3 pin alone.

parts.name: USB-C cable
parts.notes: Must carry data, not charge-only. Charge-only cables are the most common failure. If the board does not show as a USB port, try another cable first.

steps.text: One XIAO Sense, one OLED, one INMP441 mic, one MAX98357A amp, one 36 mm speaker, one breadboard, 12 jumper wires, one USB-C cable. No button, no case, no microSD in this build. Count everything before you start.
steps.title: What is in the box

steps.text: Breadboard in the middle of the table. This is the whole chassis for Demo Build 1. Nothing is enclosed yet, you need to see the wiring and feel the heat.
steps.title: Place the breadboard

steps.text: Seat the XIAO near the left of the breadboard, USB-C port facing left, camera pointing forward at the student. The camera came with the Sense kit, it stays plugged in. It runs warm, leave airflow.
steps.title: Seat the XIAO

steps.text: OLED top right. SDA to D4 (blue), SCL to D5 (yellow), VCC to 3V3 (red), GND to GND (black). Address 0x3C. If the face is blank on power-up, check D4 and D5 first.
steps.tip: 3V3 only for the OLED. Do not put it on 5V.
steps.title: Add the OLED face

steps.text: Mic bottom right. SCK to D0 (yellow), WS to D1 (green), SD to D3 (white), VDD to 3V3 (red), GND to GND (black), L/R pin to GND for left channel. Ignore the generic ESP32 GPIO numbers in the Amazon listing.
steps.tip: VDD is 1.8 to 3.3 V only. 5V will kill this mic.
steps.title: Add the INMP441 mic

steps.text: Amp bottom left. BCLK to D0 (yellow, shared with the mic), WS to D1 (green, shared), DIN to D2 (blue). If the board will not boot, move DIN to D6. VIN to 5V first, 3V3 if it buzzes.
steps.title: Add the MAX98357A amp

steps.text: Speaker sits beside the board, not on it. Speaker + to amp output +, speaker - to amp output -. Keep the mic and the speaker at opposite ends of the breadboard, mic facing the user.
steps.tip: This is the anti-echo layout. Moderate volume, mic and speaker apart, or the robot hears itself and starts a false turn.
steps.title: Connect the speaker

steps.text: Power check before USB. Mic and OLED on 3V3. Amp on 5V. Every board has a black GND wire back to the XIAO. One loose GND is the most common dead-board symptom in the lab.
steps.tip: Read the whole wiring table once more. The 3D guide shows where things go, the table says which pin is which.
steps.title: Wire power and ground

steps.text: Plug in USB-C. Arduino IDE, board XIAO_ESP32S3, PSRAM OPI, USB CDC On Boot enabled. Copy secrets.h.example to secrets.h, fill in Wi-Fi, server IP, token team-01-blue. Upload desk_robot_demo.ino.
steps.tip: Board not showing as a USB port means the cable, almost every time. Swap the cable before you reinstall anything.
steps.title: Plug in USB-C and flash

steps.text: Power on. OLED shows a crossed-out face, then the idle face after Wi-Fi connects. Talk for 2 to 3 seconds, stop, wait for the reply, usually 5 to 15 seconds. Run it three times. One success is luck, three is a demo.
steps.tip: Half-duplex: the mic is off while it speaks. Wait for the idle face, then talk. You cannot interrupt mid-reply in this build.
steps.title: First voice test
